Warm cream #f5f2e9, electric blue #2b4cf0 and coral #ef4322 lead the palette, small acid-yellow #e8ff2a accents. Bold, playful and tactile, with no gradients, glossy 3D or photorealism. No lettering, numbers, logos, watermark or drawn outer frame. Object shapes remain clear at small website display sizes.
